newsitem.title: USA: PAN AMERICAN WORLD AIWAYS ADDS ROUTE.
newsitem.headline: PAN AMERICAN WORLD AIWAYS ADDS ROUTE.

text.p: Pan American World Airways said Tuesday it will add new nonstop service between Miami and Santo Domingo, the Dominican Republic, pending government approval.
The airline also said it plans to increase service out of John F Kennedy International Airport to Santo Domingo with a second daily flight.
Pan Am said it hopes to have both the new Miami service and the expanded New York service launched by September 2.

The flights will be operated by Carnival Air Lines in a code-sharing agreement between the two, Pan Am said. Pan Am is in the process of acquiring Carnival and is awaiting shareholder and regulatory approval for the deal.
